description: This file contains JUnit 5 test cases for the EncounterTypeValidator class within the OpenMRS project. It tests validation logic for EncounterType objects, ensuring proper validation of fields like 'name' and 'description', handling duplicates, and field length constraints.

classes.name: EncounterTypeValidatorTest
classes.description: Test class for EncounterTypeValidator, verifying validation rules such as non-null, non-empty, non-whitespace names, length constraints, duplicate checks, and validation correctness during creation and editing scenarios.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the EncounterType's name is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfDescriptionIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Ensures that validation passes when the description is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredFieldsHaveProperValues
methods.description: Checks that validation passes when all fields have valid, proper values.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationWhenEditingAnExistingEncounterType
methods.description: Verifies that validation passes when editing an existing EncounterType retrieved from the database.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfEncounterTypeNameIsDuplicate
methods.description: Checks that validation fails if the new EncounterType's name duplicates an existing one.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when string length fields are within their maximum allowed lengths.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Verifies that validation fails when string length fields exceed their maximum allowed limits.
